independent_fetch.method: Fresh empty bare repositories under the session scratchpad; 'git fetch --no-tags origin' of the listed branch patterns; files read with 'git --git-dir=<bare> show <commit>:<path>'. Each registered file was additionally fetched from commit-pinned raw.githubusercontent.com and compared by bytes and SHA-256.

reading_method: Six read-only extraction passes (G1-G6) over the independently fetched repositories produced line-cited working notes (not published). Claude Code read the handoffs/decision records of all 13 fixed commits in full and checked the key claims that the deliverables take from the extraction notes against the cited SOURCE lines (the checked lines are noted in read_scope as 'Claude Code本人が…を照合'). read_scope records who read what: '抽出Gn' = extraction pass, 'Claude Code本人' = direct reading by the author.
